scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Welcome
to ^8B4513Einbroch^000000,
the City of Steel.
Please ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
歡迎來到^8B4513艾音布羅克^000000，
鋼鐵之城。
如果您有任何問題，請隨時向我諮詢。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於城市的西北部。
在那裡您可以看到我們城市的驕傲——飛空艇。
請記住，乘坐飛空艇需要支付入場費。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, perhaps the
most important facility in
Einbroch, is located in the
southern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}可能是艾音布羅克最重要的設施，
位於城市的南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, our biggest
shopping district, can be
found just east from the
center of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}是我們最大的購物區，
位於艾音布羅克中心以東。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is east of
the Plaza and offers top
caliber accomodations.
There, you can enjoy your
stay in Einbroch in comfort~
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於廣場以東，
提供頂級的住宿服務。
在那裡，您可以舒適地享受在艾音布羅克的停留~

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located in the northeast
part of Einbroch. Trains
running between here
and Einbech run all day
long, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於艾音布羅克的東北部。
往返於這裡和艾音貝赫的火車
全天執行，每天如此。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located north from the
Plaza. There you can
purchase weapons for
your personal use.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於廣場以北。
在那裡您可以購買
供個人使用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is an
annex of the Factory and
is located in the southwest
sector of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}是工廠的附屬設施，
位於艾音布羅克的西南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
I will mark the location
of the {0}
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:

我將在您的小地圖上
標記{0}的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:

by using their services.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於艾音布羅克的東南部。
您可以使用他們的服務
來升級您的裝備。

scripts.translation:

您可以前往^FF1493曼薩曼^000000，
他是位於鐵匠公會的
地下一層的^FF1493武器匠^000000。

[艾音布羅克嚮導]

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Einbech^000000,
the Mining Town. We're
here to assist tourists,
so if you have any questions,
please feel free to ask us.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
歡迎來到^8B4513艾音貝赫^000000，
這裡是採礦城鎮。我們在這裡
為遊客提供幫助，
如果您有任何問題，
請隨時向我們諮詢。
[酒館]
[ 工具店 ]
[火車站]
[礦場]
[ 卡普拉 職員 ]

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} is located
in the southern part of
Einbech. It's a nice place
to relax after a long day.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
{0}位於
艾音貝赫的南部。
這是一個在忙碌一天後
放鬆身心的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
You can find the {0} in the center of
Einbech. There, you can
purchase any tools you
might need for your travels.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
您可以在艾音貝赫的中心
找到{0}。在那裡，
您可以購買旅行中
可能需要的任何工具。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} are
located in the northwest
and northeast parts of
Einbech. There, you can
take a train to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
{0}位於
艾音貝赫的西北部和
東北部。在那裡，
您可以乘坐火車前往艾音布羅克。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0}, which is
Einbech's major industry,
is located in the northern
part of this town. It's where
we get all our ores, although monsters get in the miners' way.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
{0}是艾音貝赫的主要產業，
位於城鎮的北部。我們所有的礦石
都來自那裡，儘管魔物
總是阻礙礦工的工作。
